{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Mighty Porgy Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Mighty Porgy Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Mighty Porgy Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Mighty Porgy Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= |uses= |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Porgy|Porgies|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Creature]]s and [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Main|Armored Porgy, Mighty Porgy}} Porgies are [[Ocean]]-dwelling [[Fish]] that increase [[Link]]'s attack damage and [[Defense]] when [[Cooking|Cooked]] into [[Food]]s. Two types of Porgy exist: [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] boost Link's Defense, and [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] boost his attack power. Both types can be exclusively found in the [[Necluda Sea|Necluda]] and [[Lanayru Sea]]s. Both types of Porgy are also sold at the [[Merchant Boat]] in [[Lurelin Village]] and by the traveling [[Merchant]] [[Chumin]]. [[Porgy Meunière]]s and [[Seafood Paella]]s can be Cooked using either type of Porgies. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Main|Armored Porgy, Mighty Porgy}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Main|Armored Porgy, Mighty Porgy}} {{Stub|AoC}} Both [[Armored Porgy|Armored]] and [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] can be sold at [[Shop]]s for 10 [[Rupee]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Main|Armored Porgy, Mighty Porgy}} {{Stub|AoI}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Armored Porgy Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Icon of an Armored Porgy File:TotK Armored Porgy Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Icon of an Armored Porgy File:AoC Armored Porgy Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of an Armored Porgy File:AoC Mighty Porgy Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of a Mighty Porgy ==See Also== {{See Also| * Creature * Fish * Material }} {{Ref| {{Cite|'''Mighty Porgy'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|{{Big|Armored Porgy}}
